---
title: "R practice exercises"
format: html
---

Practice problems for data journalism in R. Everything runs in your web browser: there is nothing to install.

Each exercise box has **Run Code** and **Submit Answer** buttons. Submit to get instant feedback, including tips on writing clean tidyverse code. Stuck? Open the **Hint** or **Solution** under a question.

The first time a page loads, R and its packages download into your browser. That can take 10 to 30 seconds, so give it a moment.
